articles.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Will Get New Stories and Characters
articles.summary: An expansion pass for Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave adds weapons, outfits, characters and four story routes that were cut from the game.

articles.title: 'Tattoo (Remix)' Music Video Passes One Billion YouTube Views
articles.summary: Rauw Alejandro and Camilo's hit 'Tattoo (Remix)' has passed one billion views on YouTube, six years after it came out.

articles.title: Swimmer Archie Goodburn Helps Win New Support for Brain Cancer Patients
articles.summary: After swimmer Archie Goodburn's appeal, the UK government announced a brain cancer review and plans to speed up new treatments.
